title: CAM-54 slice 2: per-phase backend config accessor + ConfigScreen wiring (readPhaseBackend mirroring readPhaseModel)
description:
Slice 2 of the CAM-54 epic (Codex CLI as an alternative LLM backend). Follows CAM-339 (slice 1: design-spike ADR-0046/0047 + BackendAdapter seam, claude refactored into an adapter, zero behavior change). This slice is the per-phase backend selection plumbing that ADR-0047 Consequences prescribes as the mechanical follow-up (readBackend becomes a per-phase accessor mirroring readPhaseModel). It lands BEFORE any real codex dispatch (slice 3), because a CodexAdapter selectable only via the current global backend key would force all four worker actors to codex at once; mixed per-actor backend is the operator requirement stated in ADR-0046.

IN SCOPE (this slice only):
1. Add readPhaseBackend(phase, configPath?) in src/config/models.ts, mirroring readPhaseModel (models.ts:110-125) exactly: read config[backend][phase], defensive try/catch, fall back to the existing global backend form, then to DEFAULTS.backend (claude).
2. TOML shape (design decision, resolved by mirroring [models]): per-phase keys under [backend] (e.g. [backend] with implement=claude, review=claude), with BACK-COMPAT fallback preserved: a per-phase key wins, else the existing global form (top-level backend scalar OR [backend].name), else DEFAULTS.backend. No existing project.toml breaks.
3. Repoint the worker call sites to per-phase: loop.ts:1014 -> readPhaseBackend(implementer); review.ts:338 -> readPhaseBackend(reviewer) (planner/auditor call sites too if they resolve backend).
4. ConfigScreen.tsx: render backend selection PER-PHASE (like the per-phase MODEL_OPTIONS Selects on each tab) instead of once on the Global tab; extend ConfigChoices.backend from string to Record<Phase,string> mirroring models.
5. CODEX_GUARD_NOTICE stays as-is (now fires per-phase instead of globally) until the real codex adapter lands.

OUT OF SCOPE (later CAM-54 slices, do NOT do here): the real CodexAdapter dispatch impl (slice 3), mixed-backend live run, codex model-id population, orchestrator-persona/retry-launcher/auth-preflight codex parity. BackendAdapter/buildSpawnArgv seam needs ZERO changes.

ACCEPTANCE: readPhaseBackend exists and mirrors readPhaseModel with the documented fallback chain; existing project.toml (global [backend].name) still resolves for every phase; ConfigScreen renders per-phase backend Selects; both worker call sites resolve backend per-phase; typecheck + full test suite green; zero behavior change for anyone who has not set per-phase backend (still all claude).

spec.scope: Slice 2 of the CAM-54 epic: promote backend selection from global to per-phase, the mechanical additive follow-up ADR-0047 prescribes after the CAM-339 seam. Add readPhaseBackend(phase, configPath?) in src/config/models.ts mirroring readPhaseModel exactly; repoint the worker call sites to resolve backend per-phase; and render backend selection per-phase in ConfigScreen (like the existing per-phase model Selects) instead of once on the Global tab. Backend selection is an input to WHICH adapter is constructed, so the BackendAdapter/buildSpawnArgv seam itself is untouched. No real codex dispatch here (that is slice 3); the claude adapter remains the only implementation and CODEX_GUARD_NOTICE keeps firing (now per-phase) when codex is selected. Strictly additive: zero behavior change for any config that has not opted into per-phase backend.
acceptanceCriteria: readPhaseBackend(phase, configPath?) exists in src/config/models.ts and mirrors readPhaseModel (models.ts:110-125) in structure: same config-read path, defensive try/catch, same Phase type.

Fallback chain is covered by tests: a per-phase key under [backend] wins; if absent, the existing global form resolves (top-level backend scalar OR [backend].name); if absent, DEFAULTS.backend (claude).
Back-compat test: an existing project.toml carrying only [backend] name=claude resolves to claude for EVERY phase, unchanged.

The implementer worker call site (loop.ts:1014) and the reviewer call site (review.ts:338) resolve backend via readPhaseBackend for their phase instead of the global readBackend(); planner/auditor call sites likewise if they resolve backend.

ConfigScreen.tsx renders a per-phase backend Select on each phase tab (mirroring the per-phase MODEL_OPTIONS Selects); ConfigChoices.backend is Record<Phase,string> (mirroring models); no global-only backend field remains on the Global tab.
The BackendAdapter interface and ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv in src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts are unchanged (no diff to the seam).
typecheck clean and the full test suite is green; zero behavior change when no per-phase backend is set (every phase still resolves claude).
gotchas: readBackend (models.ts:171) is currently GLOBAL (no phase arg). Preserve its back-compat forms in the new accessor: existing configs use [backend] name=claude AND a top-level backend=... scalar is also accepted. readPhaseBackend must fall back per-phase-key -> global form -> DEFAULTS.backend, or existing project.toml stops resolving.

Do NOT touch the BackendAdapter seam. buildSpawnArgv(actor, opts) in backend-adapter.ts stays byte-identical; backend selection chooses WHICH adapter is constructed at the call site, it is not a parameter of the seam.
ClaudeAdapter must remain the ONLY implementation this slice. No CodexAdapter, no codex argv, no codex dispatch. Out of scope; that is slice 3.
CODEX_GUARD_NOTICE in src/logging/spawn-resolution.ts must stay: it fires when a resolved backend is codex and will now fire per-phase instead of globally. Keep it until the real codex adapter lands.

WorkerActor (implementer|planner|auditor|reviewer) and Phase may be named/typed differently. readPhaseModel takes Phase; readPhaseBackend must use the SAME Phase type readPhaseModel uses, and each call site maps its actor to the correct phase (do not invent a new enum).

run.ts orchestrator spawn (buildOrchestratorPaneCommand, run.ts:267) hardcodes claude and is deliberately NOT behind the adapter (deferred to a later slice). If run.ts resolves backend only for spawn-resolution logging, keep that as-is; do not wire the orchestrator to per-phase backend here.

ConfigChoices.backend is currently a plain string (global). Widen it to Record<Phase,string> exactly the way models: Record<Phase,string> already works; reuse the per-phase model rendering pattern rather than inventing a new one.
domainTerms: BackendAdapter: the seam interface (backend-adapter.ts) exposing buildSpawnArgv(actor, opts); ClaudeAdapter is its only implementation.
readPhaseModel / readBackend / readPhaseBackend: per-phase model accessor (exists), global backend accessor (exists, models.ts:171), and the new per-phase backend accessor this slice adds.
Phase / WorkerActor: the per-phase config key type vs the four worker actors (implementer|planner|auditor|reviewer) resolved at spawn.
ConfigChoices / ConfigScreen / BACKEND_OPTIONS / MODEL_OPTIONS: the TUI config model (ConfigScreen.tsx), its per-field choice options, and the per-phase Select rendering pattern to mirror.
CODEX_GUARD_NOTICE: informational non-blocking notice (spawn-resolution.ts) emitted when a resolved backend is codex, since codex dispatch is not yet wired.
project.toml [backend]/[models]: the TOML config sections; [models] is already per-phase, [backend] is currently global and gains per-phase keys this slice.
